limitations.title: Listing-price basis
limitations.body: Benchmarks use daily guide-style listing prices, not executed transaction prices.

limitations.title: MVP source data
limitations.body: Current index values are repo-managed MVP fixtures. Official Cardmarket downloads and schemas are checked daily, but real values require an accumulated daily snapshot history.

limitations.title: Validation history
limitations.body: Observations before 2026-07-20 validate the product surfaces only. Public return and risk analytics start at formal MVP inception.

limitations.title: No raw price exposure
limitations.body: Public files expose derived index values, summaries, constituents, status, and reports only.

limitations.title: Carry-forward rule
limitations.body: Missing constituent observations may be carried forward for a limited window and are counted in the public status surface.

checks.label: Manifest checksums
checks.detail: Every exported public JSON file is listed with a SHA-256 checksum.

checks.label: Static JSON contract
checks.detail: The first page load reads generated static files and does not require Supabase.

checks.label: Cardmarket source confirmation
checks.detail: Official One Piece and Pokemon price-guide and catalogue URLs are verified by a scheduled schema and coverage check.

checks.label: MVP update cadence
checks.detail: Repository-managed benchmark data updates only when a reviewed JSON change is committed; stale dates remain visible in the interface.
